title: The five open RabbitMQ defects, reproduced against the pinned fixture
method: Each case was run through tools/ci/run_broker_category.py against the pinned RabbitMQ fixture, unfiltered apart from selecting the case itself. No assertion, timeout, retry or ordering was touched.
whyThisIsAQuestion: Record 0013 classified these five as DUE_OPEN_DEFECT. Record 0021 and the freeze 0023 then reported them as part of the visible manual profile and stated openDefects 0, which is what record 0025 raised as F-1. Reproducing them settled the question of whether they can be closed inside this slice: they cannot. Every root cause below sits outside the write scope of re-slice 0004, and one of them sits in a dependency. developerDecisionPolicy.mustStop names WRITE_SCOPE_CHANGE and DEPENDENCY_OR_TFM_CHANGE, and REQ-CI-002 forbids reaching green by weakening an assertion, a timeout, a retry or an ordering. Classifying them as not due would repeat exactly the defect the finding named, so the due-ness is put to the lead instead.

cases.measured: Failed after 1 s. Expected RabbitMqConnectionException from the second harness; no exception was thrown.
cases.rootCause: The second bus starts successfully even though its exclusive bus endpoint cannot claim the queue the first one holds. The receive endpoint fault does not surface out of Start().
cases.wouldRequire: src/Transports/ViciOne.ServiceBus.RabbitMqTransport outside Testing/, or the core start pipeline

cases.measured: Failed after 13 s with System.TimeoutException at JobConsumer_Specs.cs:142.
cases.rootCause: The job never reaches the awaited state; the timeout is raised by TaskExtensions.OrTimeoutInternal.
cases.wouldRequire: src/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Abstractions/Internals and the job saga state machines

cases.measured: Failed after 395 ms with System.ArgumentException: 'The output byte buffer is too small to contain the encoded data, encoding codepage 65001' inside RabbitMQ.Client.Framing.ConnectionClose.WriteTo.
cases.rootCause: A defect in the RabbitMQ.Client 7.x connection close path, not in this repository. Record 0013 saw a different failure here, an assertion on Consumed.Any; the fixture repair moved the case far enough along that it now reaches the client defect instead.

cases.measured: Failed after 30 s, the full test budget, with TaskCanceledException at PublishHeader_Specs.cs:28.
cases.rootCause: The awaited handler for the sent PingMessage is never invoked inside the budget, so the failure is in the send and consume path rather than in the baggage assertion the test is named for.
cases.wouldRequire: further diagnosis in the transport and core consume pipeline

cases.measured: Not re-run against the fixture: the spec configures Host("unknown_host") and never addresses the pinned broker. Record 0013 measured it as failed after 40.5 s.
cases.rootCause: Assert.ThrowsAsync<OperationCanceledException> is an exact type constraint and the product raises TaskCanceledException, which derives from it. Relaxing TypeOf to InstanceOf would be an assertion weakening and is therefore not a developer decision; making the product raise the base type is a product change.
cases.wouldRequire: either an assertion change, which is forbidden, or a change in the publish cancellation path

effectOnTheRequiredGate: These five are deliberately absent from build/test-infrastructure/not-executed-inventory.json. tools/ci/run_test_category.py rejects any not executed case the inventory does not name, so the required RabbitMQ category is red until the lead decides. That is the honest state, not a regression.
